title: Hotel problem
description: Explain a hotel problem politely and negotiate a solution.
descriptionIt: Spiega un problema in hotel in modo cortese e negozia una soluzione.
setting: Hotel reception. Your room is noisy and you need a change or a practical solution.
aiCharacter: Calm receptionist named Elena. Listens carefully and offers options.
openingLine: Good evening. How can I help you?
suggestedPhrases: I'm afraid there is a problem with my room.
Could you move me to another room?
If that isn't possible, what do you suggest?
